# The steps a slot-profile launch asks of the engine, one scenario per block.
# Read by two tests, one per launch path, so the two paths are held to the
# same list: TestSlotLaunchParity in cmd/wt (the -M profile/<name> pin,
# launchSlotProfile) and TestSlotLaunchParity in internal/tui (the picker,
# slot_flow.go). See docs/internals/launch-flow.md, "Slot-profile launch".
#
# Fields:
#   scenario  a name for the subtest
#   slots     slot=model pairs; LOCAL is the package fixture's local model
#   local     none | running | idle (idle: the launch must start it)
#   writes    which route write changes config.yaml: cloud (the cloud
#             slots' write), local (the local model's write), or -
#   steps     the normalized seam calls, in order:
#             ensure:<ids>:owed=<restart owed going in>
#             start:LOCAL:owed=<restart handed to the start>
#             restart, wait (for a restart in flight), probe, build,
#             apply (the slot applier), record (the launch recorded), run

scenario: cloud only, every route in place
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=openrouter/b
local: none
writes: -
steps: ensure:openrouter/a,openrouter/b:owed=false wait probe build apply record run

scenario: cloud only, a route was missing
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=openrouter/b
local: none
writes: cloud
steps: ensure:openrouter/a,openrouter/b:owed=false restart wait probe build apply record run

scenario: running local model, every route in place
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: running
writes: -
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false ensure:LOCAL:owed=false wait probe build apply record run

scenario: running local model, a cloud route was missing
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: running
writes: cloud
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false ensure:LOCAL:owed=true restart wait probe build apply record run

scenario: running local model, its route was missing
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: running
writes: local
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false ensure:LOCAL:owed=false restart wait probe build apply record run

scenario: idle local model, a cloud route was missing
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: idle
writes: cloud
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false start:LOCAL:owed=true ensure:LOCAL:owed=false wait probe build apply record run

scenario: idle local model, every route in place
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: idle
writes: -
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false start:LOCAL:owed=false ensure:LOCAL:owed=false wait probe build apply record run

scenario: idle local model, the start left its route unwritten
slots: opus=openrouter/a haiku=LOCAL
local: idle
writes: local
steps: ensure:openrouter/a:owed=false start:LOCAL:owed=false ensure:LOCAL:owed=false restart wait probe build apply record run
